description: PLATEAU 4 terrain with a hole in its triangulation (the 08-dem Z-04-HOLES quality-check input) read and written back: all nine triangles are written as dem:tin > gml:TriangulatedSurface > gml:trianglePatches > gml:Triangle with the source's posList verbatim and no ids, and dem:lod comes before dem:tin. The writer does not fill or flag the gap, which is the quality-check actions' job. New-world only: the legacy writer has no terrain support.
